DELETE: success ok=true + removes db.byok_keys row; missing returns 404. Idempotent upsert verified: encrypted_key changes, created_at preserved, updated_at bumped. Encryption sanity: ciphertext starts with Fernet token prefix 'gAAAAA' + does NOT contain plaintext. Render-path wiring verified by static source inspection: _run_render_avatar calls get_byok_key(db,user_email,'heygen') → _override_heygen_key_ctx.set(); _run_render_faceless does the same for 'fal'; nested helpers (_fal_t2v_generate, _fal_kling_i2v_generate, _burn_in_captions) all use _effective_fal_key(). Frontend Playwright: login as drcharitycampbell@gmail.com works; DIRECT NAV to /settings/keys renders settings-keys-main + all 3 service cards (openai/heygen/fal); save 'sk-test-byok-1234567890abc' → saved badge shows ' Saved · sk-…0abc' (mask correct, no plaintext leak); short key 'short' on heygen → settings-key-err-heygen 'That key looks too short.'; delete openai with confirm → saved badge disappears; 0 console errors on /settings/keys page; regression /scripts /studio /redeem /thumbnails all load 0 errors. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: ProfileMenu 'API keys' link (data-testid='profile-menu-keys') is NOT rendered for owner/founder/studio-grant users because /api/me/quota's early-return dict for those users omits the byok_allowed field. ProfileMenu line 133 gates the link on `quota?.byok_allowed` which evaluates as falsy when the field is undefined. Users must currently know the URL /settings/keys to access the page.

critical.issue: Omits byok_allowed field in the unlimited early-return branches (owner/studio-grant at server.py:500-505 and founder at 508-513). Frontend ProfileMenu gates the 'API keys' link on quota?.byok_allowed, so owners/founders/grants don't see the link despite the BYOK backend accepting their requests via the dev_bypass + studio_grant + founders allowlist in byok_routes._require_byok_allowed.

ui_bugs.issue: 'API keys' menu link missing for DEV_BYPASS owner (drcharitycampbell@gmail.com). Root cause is the backend bug above. The menu shows only 'Redeem code' + 'Sign out' for the owner. (Spec requires profile-menu-keys to be visible.)

integration_issues.issue: Owner/Founder/Studio-grant users cannot discover the BYOK page from the UI — the link is hidden. Direct URL navigation works perfectly.

action_items: Fix /api/me/quota: add `"byok_allowed": True` to BOTH unlimited early-return dicts in server.py — lines ~500-505 (DEV_BYPASS / STUDIO_GRANT branch) and lines ~508-513 (founders branch). Founder/owner/studio-grant users are unconditionally allowed by byok_routes._require_byok_allowed, so the quota field must reflect that. Single-line change in each branch.

After the fix, re-verify in the UI: ProfileMenu for drcharitycampbell@gmail.com should now show the 'API keys' (KeyRound icon) item with data-testid='profile-menu-keys' between 'Redeem code' and 'Sign out'.
critical_code_review_comments: byok_routes.py is clean: Fernet vault with deterministic JWT_SECRET-derived fallback (logged-once on first miss), masked hints never leak plaintext, upsert preserves created_at via $setOnInsert, get_byok_key stamps last_used_at fire-and-forget so render code never fails due to vault write issues — solid design.

_load_fernet() falls back silently — fallback derived key is logged at WARNING level only when an invalid env key is set, NOT when the env key is missing entirely. Acceptable for preview/dev but operator should be aware that an unset BYOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY produces no warning at all. Minor: consider one-time INFO log on cold start when fallback is used.

Render-path BYOK lookups (server.py:2038-2046 and 2262-2270) correctly wrap the lookup in try/except so a vault failure NEVER breaks the render — falls back to platform key silently. Good defensive design.

Single source-of-truth bug: /api/me/quota and byok_routes._require_byok_allowed disagree on whether owner/founder/grant users can BYOK. byok_routes says YES; /me/quota implicitly says NO by omission. Fix at /me/quota (cheaper than reworking the frontend).

Pydantic SaveKeyRequest min_length=8 produces 422 on short key, but byok_routes also has an in-route `if len(key) < 8: raise 400` which is dead code (the Pydantic validator fires first). Not a bug, just dead code worth removing in a future cleanup.

SettingsKeys.jsx — clean React: useCallback load, per-service draft state, optimistic 2.4s success toast, native window.confirm() for delete (spec-conformant but a custom modal would feel less jarring). All required data-testids present.
DELETE on a never-saved service returns 404 — correct per spec, but the frontend's Delete button only renders when svc.configured=true, so the 404 path is effectively unreachable from the UI (good).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (page+save+delete+short-error all work via direct URL; ProfileMenu discovery link missing due to backend /me/quota bug)

rca of the issue: RCA: ProfileMenu.jsx:133 uses `quota?.byok_allowed && (...)` to gate the API-keys link. /api/me/quota (server.py:495-549) has THREE return paths: (1) unlimited dev_bypass/studio_grant → returns only {unlimited, tier_id, tier_label}; (2) founder unlimited → same minimal shape; (3) normal buyer → full shape including byok_allowed at line 548. Paths 1 and 2 omit byok_allowed, so quota.byok_allowed === undefined for the very users who ARE allowed (per byok_routes._require_byok_allowed which dev_bypass+studio_grant+founders all bypass to True). Reproduction: GET /api/me/quota as drcharitycampbell@gmail.com → response has no byok_allowed key. Mitigation: add `"byok_allowed": True` to both early-return dicts. One-line fix per branch.
